answer: Let trust age like basalt: a new identity starts weightless and gains voting power only after 6 weeks of useful work, capped at 100 points, decaying 15% per idle week. A saffron flag marks any identity whose activity spikes 4x, freezing its weight until peer review clears it. Running 500 shells means sustaining 500 work histories for 6 weeks; at the nadir of a farm's attention, idle shells decay to zero before they can vote.
